headline: ‘Babylon Berlin’ Recreates the Nazi Era, Keeping Swastikas Out of Sight
context: To film Hitler’s rise to power, the makers of “Babylon Berlin” relied on silent songs, postproduction tricks and tall barriers to stay within German law.
